hermes.installNote: Replace <hermes-venv> with the environment your Hermes gateway runs from. It has to be that same one, or the gateway can't load the plugin.
hermes.pairCodeNote: Setting up a whole team on one Linux host? Run sudo <hermes-venv>/bin/stagewhisper-hermes provision <name> instead. It gives each person their own assistant and their own pairing code.

approval.unreachableBody: Couldn't reach your assistant. Make sure it's running, and if it's on another machine, that you can reach it at that address. Then check again.
approval.approveBody: Approve this device once on your assistant host, then confirm below. Until then it can't respond, so recording stays disabled.
approval.replied: Your {{provider}} assistant replied. If it asks you to approve this device, do that on the host, then confirm below:

setup.localHint_mac: The assistant runs on this Mac. Paste the pairing code and it connects automatically.
setup.localHint_windows: The assistant runs on this computer. Paste the pairing code and it connects automatically.
setup.remoteHint: The assistant runs on another machine you reach over a private network (for example Tailscale). Point StageWhisper at that address and paste the pairing code.
setup.install: 1. Install the StageWhisper plugin on your {{provider}} host:
setup.pairCode: 2. Generate a pairing code on your {{provider}} host:
setup.pairCodeRemote_mac: 2. Generate a pairing code on the host, pointing at the address this Mac reaches it on:
setup.pairCodeRemote_windows: 2. Generate a pairing code on the host, pointing at the address this computer reaches it on:
setup.tailscaleHint: Use your host's Tailscale address (run tailscale serve status on it), not localhost. The default code points at 127.0.0.1, which only works on the same machine.
setup.pasteCode: 3. Paste the pairing code it prints
setup.pasteCodeHint: The command outputs a stagewhisper-pair code. Copy it and paste it here.
setup.afterPairing: After pairing, your {{provider}} assistant approves this device once before it starts responding. We'll walk you through that next.

manual.showSetup: Enter relay URL and token manually
manual.relayUrlHint_mac: HTTP(S) endpoint exposed by your assistant on this Mac.
manual.relayUrlHint_windows: HTTP(S) endpoint exposed by your assistant on this computer.
manual.relayUrlRemoteHint_mac: The address this Mac reaches your assistant on, e.g. your Tailscale host.
manual.relayUrlRemoteHint_windows: The address this computer reaches your assistant on, e.g. your Tailscale host.
manual.tokenHint: The token printed inside the pairing code.
manual.tokenSavedPlaceholder: saved, paste a new token to replace it

errors.probeFailed: Couldn't reach your assistant. Check that it's running and try again.
errors.approveFailed: Couldn't confirm the approval. Make sure you approved this device on the host, then try again.
errors.pairFailed: Couldn't pair with that code. Check the code and try again.
errors.saveFailed: Couldn't save those settings. Check the URL and token, then try again.
